A '''bluehair spider''' was a type of [[Spider/Legends|spider]] that existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. In [[44 ABY]], it was featured in the [[Javat Caridan Children's Animal Habitat]] where children can learn more about it.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
